title: Auritus
description:
Open-source (MIT) just-in-time TTS embed for the web: drop-in player, client-side generator, AWS CDK backend with DynamoDB mutex, local GPU worker race, and AWS Batch fallback. TTS backends: Higgs + Qwen 3 (pluggable). Operator auth: Cognito + Google. Browser auth: site keys. Site: aurit.us on Amplify. CLI on PyPI via semantic-release.

Architect plans and reviews; coding agents implement Stories with step-by-step briefs. Behavior-driven (Gherkin in features/). Git Flow: develop integrates, main releases.
right_now_summary: Auritus is live, with AWS checks, CI gates, and PyPI release hardening still underway.
